description: Verify that TCP in SYN-RCVD goes to LISTEN on receiving SYN (or SYN+ACK) in window (RFC 1122 §4.2.2.20(e) p94). 2 iterations exercise stp ∈ {SYN in window, SYN+ACK in window}
approach:
[Objective]
If a SYN-RCVD socket sees an in-window SYN (or SYN,ACK), the half-open connection is treated as stale and DUT returns to LISTEN. Verified by injecting a fresh SYN and seeing SYN,ACK answered.

[Scenario — chronological]
Two phases:
• Phase 1: prelude SYN → DUT SYN,ACK (SYN-RCVD) → tester injects in-window SYN → fresh SYN → DUT must SYN,ACK.
• Phase 2: same but the inject is SYN+ACK in window.

[Pass condition]
Fresh SYN gets SYN,ACK in both phases.

[Fail condition]
Per phase: Fail_p<n>_no_prelude_synack / Fail_p<n>_no_verify_synack.

verdicts.Pass: DUT returned to LISTEN on in-window SYN(+ACK) — normal
verdicts.Fail_p1_no_prelude_synack: No DUT SYN,ACK to prelude SYN phase 1
verdicts.Fail_p1_no_verify_synack: No DUT SYN,ACK to verify SYN after in-window SYN
verdicts.Fail_p2_no_prelude_synack: No DUT SYN,ACK to prelude SYN phase 2
verdicts.Fail_p2_no_verify_synack: No DUT SYN,ACK to verify SYN after in-window SYN+ACK
